name: AT - Autoridade Tributaria e Aduaneira (Portugal)

provenance.sourceText: backend/src/modules/documents/reporting/data/pt.json and reporting/providers/pt-at (the one implemented DeclarationProvider documents-core.module.ts registers, buildPtAtDeclarationProvider) -- see CLAUDE.md's own 'reporting/' section: 'Two data files, pt.json and fr.json, but exactly ONE implemented DeclarationProvider: pt-at'.

notes: Portugal's OWN tax authority, not a commercial vendor -- exactly one operator, the same reasoning 'chorus-pro'/'ksef'/'sdi' hold.

offerings.description: Portugal's own tax authority, for declaring invoice data after issuance.

sandbox.notes: Portuguese NIF, subutilizador and an X.509 certificate signed by the AT are the blockers -- purely administrative to obtain (no accreditation gate), but not obtained by this session.

provenance.sourceText: backend/src/modules/documents/reporting/data/pt.json and reporting/providers/pt-at (the one implemented DeclarationProvider documents-core.module.ts registers, buildPtAtDeclarationProvider).

offerings.notes: NOT a delivery channel and deliberately has no 'transportId': 'pt-at' is registered in the SEPARATE declaration-provider registry (documents-core.module.ts, the 'declaration providers' section), never in transports/transport-registry.ts -- a Portuguese invoice still leaves by whatever ordinary transport the company chose (e.g. 'email'); this offering only discharges the SELLER's post-issuance duty to communicate invoice data to the AT ('comunicacao de faturas'), the same distinction channels.service.ts#reportingObligations draws between a channel and a declaration.
